## Summary of the Pull Request

Copilot ACP now handles Yolo-off permission requests correctly. Remove the Copilot-specific prompt restriction so Yolo-off sessions use the standard permission flow.

## References and Relevant Issues

## Detailed Description of the Pull Request / Additional comments

Removes the Copilot-only compatibility check and its associated version handling, tests, and documentation. Provider-native Yolo reconciliation and policy behavior remain unchanged.

## Validation Steps Performed

Focused standard-path and hot-disable tests passed. Native Yolo: 37 passed. Full WTA: 2,005 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored. Exact package build/deploy/freshness passed. Fresh Copilot Off and Claude-to-Copilot Off real-provider E2E passed with permission prompts and no marker side effects.
